title: Lipschitz equivalent Banach spaces need not be linearly isomorphic

result.label: Lipschitz equivalent Banach spaces need not be linearly isomorphic
result.statement: Constructs separable real Banach spaces that are globally bi-Lipschitz equivalent but not linearly isomorphic, resolving the separable Lipschitz-isomorphism problem negatively. Thus even the complete metric structure up to bi-Lipschitz equivalence does not determine a separable Banach space's linear isomorphism class.
